text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while looking through my smartphone's
photo album...
a single photo caught my eye.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Back when Jungle Pocket slipped her arms
into her completed racing silks for the very first time...――

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa!
Looking good!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty,
let's show it to them too♪

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Everyone!
Look!

text_block_list.name: Pocket's Pals
text_block_list.text:
Huh?!
Pokke-san, those clothes...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
This is my racing outfit!
Pretty sick, right?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
First, the jacket! It's so stylish.
Thought I'd swagger around with my shoulders held high.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Gotta keep the stomach light so I can yell at the top of my lungs! Ya don't want nothin' gettin' in the way once ya win, right? And then—

text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I—

text_block_list.name: Pocket's Pals
text_block_list.text: So cute...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Gasp!! I-I'm so sorry...!
Talking back to Pokke-san like that...!
No, that's not it, I wasn't trying to look down on you—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Right on~!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
It's got ribbons, and the skirt's all fluffy.
It looks crazy good on me. Pretty cute, right?♪

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: But that ain't all!

text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Huh!
Pokke-san!?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Uraaaaaaaaghh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Jungle Pocket suddenly sprinted onto the freestyle course.
Her animal-print cloth fluttered as she violently kicked up the turf, looking like—

text_block_list.name: Pocket's Pals
text_block_list.text:
S-S-So...――
SOOOO FREAKIN' COOOOOOL!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Racewear is basically,
like a tokko-fuku, y'know?"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: My resolve to leave this place and take on the Twinkle Series is no joke.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Cute, cool, whatever it is—I'm breaking through!
I'll carve out my own damn way of life!"

text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... She's invincible...!
P pocket-san really is so freakin' cool...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Haha.
Isn't it obvious?"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, partner, I haven't heard your thoughts yet.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
So, what do you think of me in my racewear?!
choice_data_list: (It's a bit hard to say it's cute, though...)
Of course, you look so cool!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The word "cute" crossed my mind instinctively... but somehow, I hesitated to say it straight out.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you just thought something, didn't you?
Just spit it out.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Don't hesitate.
We're in this together, aren't we?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Take that!
...Whoa, wait, what?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"...Your voice is too quiet.
Say it with more confidence."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Not nearly loud enough.
Scream!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
More!
Shout from your gut!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: —Alright, that's enough♪

text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, Trainer...
You must've screamed like a hundred times...
Well, she's that cute, so I guess you couldn't help it...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, let's take a commemorative photo.
Come on, partner, let's take one!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heh... guess there's no helping it.
In exchange, you'd better make it count, got it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The photo taken back then rests in my hands.
I'll treasure it along with those memories...
I reaffirmed that feeling to myself once more.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: I suppose so.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
As expected of my partner.
You really get it, don'tcha?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Oh yeah, let's take a commemorative photo!
Trainer, you mind handling the camera?"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Alright, everyone gather 'round.

text_block_list.name: Pocket's Pals
text_block_list.text: Ouss!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When Jungle Pocket called out,
friends gathered from all around.
Once everyone was packed together――

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? Hey, you over there.
Get in closer. You're gonna get cut out of the shot!

text_block_list.name: Newcomer Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"N-No, I'm fine, really...! Running alongside
Pokke-san... would be way too much for me—"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Come on. You came all this way prepared to face it, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
The only one who can raise you up
is yourself. ...What're you gonna do?

text_block_list.name: Newcomer Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...!
...E-Excuse me, mind if I take the seat next to you...?!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Alright then, Trainer!
I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The photo taken back then rests in my hands.
I'll treasure it along with those memories...
I reaffirmed that feeling to myself once more.
